description: Na₆V₂C₄SO₁₆ crystallizes in the cubic Fd̅3 space group. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with eight equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent VO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one SO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 61-84°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.51 Å. V is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form VO₆ octahedra that share edges with six equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. All V-O bond lengths are 2.18 Å. C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three equivalent O atoms. All C-O bond lengths are 1.30 Å. S is bonded to four equivalent O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share edges with six equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. All S-O bond lengths are 1.50 Å. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to three equivalent Na and one S atom to form distorted edge-sharing ONa₃S trigonal pyramids. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one V, and one C atom.
